name: agentic-hq
description: Agentic HQ - Orchestrating agentic software development teams
// files: Tarball whitelist (AHQ-196). dist/ is gitignored, so without this the packer would exclude the build output. run-workflow.cjs is whitelisted as a single file — scripts/mcp-scripts/ is a dev-machine installer that must not ship. Tarball hygiene proper is AHQ-198.
// publishConfig: Applied by `pnpm pack` AT PACK TIME ONLY (npm's packer does not do this): the tarball's manifest gets the prebuilt bin + compiled-JS exports while the working tree keeps the dev values (tsx bin, .ts exports) untouched. See AHQ-196.

scripts.// POSTINSTALL: FIX: node-pty posix_spawnp failed on macOS. pnpm extracts spawn-helper binary with -rw-r--r-- instead of -rwxr-xr-x. Known pnpm bug: https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm/issues/7366. Mac-only (darwin-*), fails silently on other platforms.
scripts.// BUILD: Compiles the CLI graph + shipped math workflow to dist/ for the prebuilt npm package (AHQ-196). Clean build every time so outputs of since-deleted sources can never linger into an artifact.
scripts.// VALIDATION: validate = typecheck + lint + format + unit tests (REQUIRED before commits)
scripts.validate: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint:check && pnpm format:check && pnpm test
scripts.validate:all: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint:check && pnpm format:check && pnpm test:all
scripts.// demo:agentic-hq-cli: Uses 'node bin/agentic-hq.cjs' directly — self-contained, no global PATH dependency (same as the e2e test)
scripts.// DEMO: STRING REVERSAL: Two ways to run the string reversal demo (override the built-in default with -- --string-to-reverse='your string')
scripts.// demo:plugin-direct: Runs the EXACT command the skill returns (cd + pnpm install + pnpm demo:<workflow>), bypassing the agentic-hq CLI
scripts.// TEST COMMANDS: test = unit tests, test:unit = same as test, test:all = unit + integration + e2e
scripts.test:all: pnpm test && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.// test:e2e:cross-workspace-demo-math-wo: Needs `pnpm build` first: the math-workflow SKILL.md now runs the prebuilt workflow JS from dist/ (AHQ-196). Interim state — AHQ-197's build-first mode retires the prefix.
scripts.// WATCH MODE DISABLED: Watch mode causes AI test execution to hang

// node-pty: Pinned to an EXACT version (no ^) on purpose — supply-chain safety. Its install/build script is ALLOWED to run on Linux (AHQ-170: node-pty ships no linux-x64 prebuild, so it compiles from source on install), which means a new release would execute its own code at install time. An auto-bumped (^) version could therefore run a compromised release's build script. Keep pinned; upgrade ONLY manually after reviewing the release. See https://agentic-hq.atlassian.net/browse/AHQ-170
// @types/node: Pinned to the LOWEST supported Node major (22), not the newest. @types/node's major should track the oldest Node LTS the project supports so typecheck reflects that runtime's API surface. See AHQ-145.
